_comment: Both flags were set by nothing, so neither of Briar's hero abilities could ever fire. 'The FIRST TIME ... this turn' is a once-per-turn gate on the trigger, not a flag, and it is checked after every other condition so a trigger whose conditions failed does not burn the turn's single use. 'Your SECOND non-attack action card' must be an EXACT count: a >= test stays true for the third and every later play, turning 'the second' into 'the second and every one after'.
